concerns.text: FR-011 has two halves: (a) validate MODIS covariates against in-situ weather station records (NOAA GHCN) and (b) ≥95% coverage completeness. T003 implements only (b) ('Validate coverage: cells with <95% valid observations are logged and excluded'). No task performs any GHCN/in-situ comparison, so half of FR-011 has no implementing task.

concerns.location: spec.md:FR-006, SC-002, US-2 scenario 1 vs tasks.md:T008
concerns.text: FR-006 mandates a Diebold–Mariano test on prediction errors; T008 unilaterally replaces it with a Spatial Block Permutation Test ('replacing the Diebold–Mariano test per plan.md'). The spec is the authoritative requirement and was never amended, so no task covers FR-006/SC-002/US-2-scenario-1 as written (DM test, p<0.05 vs naive baseline). Either add a DM-test task or route a spec amendment first.

FR-008 requires the effort covariate to be included 'as an additional predictor' in the model. T004 explicitly excludes it ('effort used ONLY for threshold adjustment, never as a model predictor — FR-003, FR-008'). No task implements FR-008 as specified; the coverage table claims T004 covers FR-008 via a schema column, which does not satisfy the predictor requirement.

FR-007 and SC-006 require continental-scale maps; T010 produces only regional Pacific Northwest maps ('predict arrival week for every valid grid cell in the regional extent'). The scope narrowing exists in plan.md but not in the spec, so the FR-007/SC-006 requirement as written has no covering task.
